business_challenges: Rep workflow friction — manual processes slowing down outreach and follow-up activity
Salesforce data desync — CRM records are not being updated reliably, creating visibility gaps for leadership
Low sales tool adoption — difficulty ensuring all AEs are consistently using and getting value from tooling
Lack of engagement signals — limited visibility into prospect behavior such as email opens, clicks, and responsiveness
Inefficient follow-up cadences — no structured, repeatable process for timely outreach across the team
Longer-than-desired sales cycles — deals stalling due to inconsistent rep activity and follow-through
desired_outcomes: Automate rep follow-up so no deal goes cold due to missed outreach
Eliminate manual Salesforce logging — all email activity, engagement, and tasks sync automatically
Drive adoption across all AEs with an inbox-native tool that requires minimal behaviour change
Provide real-time engagement signals (opens, clicks, devices, timing) to help reps prioritize their pipeline
Give leadership and Sales Ops visibility into rep activity, sequence usage, and leading indicators
Integrate with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Gong to consolidate the sales workflow in one place
Enable structured sequences with multi-channel steps to shorten cycles
trial_activities: Install Mixmax across all trial AEs and confirm Salesforce integration is syncing activity correctly
Send at least 5 tracked emails and review open, click, and engagement data in the sidebar
Set up scheduling links and confirm calendar availability is displaying correctly; test booking on behalf of another rep
Build and launch one sequence with a minimum of 3 steps (email, LinkedIn task, follow-up email) for an active prospecting motion
Enroll at least 10 contacts into a sequence via Salesforce report or CSV
Create a shared email template that the full team can pull from inside their inbox
Set up at least one automated workflow rule (e.g. pre-meeting email)
Review Salesforce Insights report to confirm activity is tracking accurately
Use sequence step completion metrics to validate adoption — identify any AEs with zero sequence activity

success_metrics.target: 90%+ of trial AEs actively using Mixmax (sequences enrolled, emails tracked)
100% of outbound emails and key activities logging to correct CRM records
Measurable improvement in reply rates and follow-up consistency vs. baseline
Increase in meetings booked per rep — target fewer than 7 touches to book vs. industry average of 18
Reps self-report reduced time on manual logging and follow-up management
Sales Ops and leadership can pull accurate activity and pipeline reports from Salesforce
Early signal of shorter time-to-next-step, target 50% reduction in sales cycle length
